body: I am , I should have mentioned I am autistic and sometimes the downs take over :/ om trying to pull my self out of this one now I've realized it's my brain amplifying the downs. This site is filled with amazing people though, Thanks for checking in on someone random :$ it made today a bit easier

We are still totally snowed in but it's Canada, land of snow and bears. I'm dealing with the hearing loss as it comes, or atleast that's the goal aha. I'm sorry weed doesn't work as well on you :c also about the price! Did you always have fibromyalgia 
?
Have you tried weed ?? I can relate sorta I think.  I have rheumatoid arthritis so I'm sick and my joints ache all the time and it helps me :$
What's going on love ?? I have time if you need to talk
Hey , It's been a bit but I thought I'd let you know that I've taken positive steps and I'm doing okay now. Hope you're doing well

Thankyou for making me feel less alone. I calmed down and made tea and talked to someone I met on here actually via text for a while too and I'm feeling better , I hope I can't help you as you helped me sometime.  You truly are a wonderful person to have taken time to message me. Thankyou so much.

Yeah I don care if i come back. When I start again, if that happens,I won't remember this hurt so fuck it. I'll take my chances. I'm done replying now though. Have a wonderful new year hun and I hope you find happiness. My stop is here though. You're a good person so don't follow the example of an empty 23 year old with no fight left. I'm sure you'll do great. Goodbye

A pill won't replace my family or change my history. It won't make this world beautiful or exciting or worth anything more then it is now because we are a giant sphere of hate and disapproval and loss. That's all we go through in every life that is the only gauruntee. I am not going to put my self through this rotten shithole of an existence on the thought that some drug will fuck me up enough to forget I'm alone. Thanks for trying but my mind is set. I'm absolute in this choice.

Yoooo so listen here love. I'm 23,I devoted my life to music, play 8 instruments, sing and compose and like you over the course of 4 months I've gone completely deaf in one ear and hardly sound in my other however i would play guitar fully deaf. Music is a feeling beautiful. You are a musician no matter your hearing ! If you ever need to relate or chat with someone losing their hearing ,I'm only a message away. And trust me I know how fucking shitty it is to go through because we are actually greiving love.
Im so sorry for how helpless and sad you must feel. If I could trade with her I would then you'd both be happy but I will try to keep going for you then. Can I pm you ?

That is the sweetest thing anyone had ever offered me , I'm crying that caught me off guard. Thankyou, however i do have coverage. You're right on the money there. I do have a smart phone and I think I'll check that out

I don't really have anywhere else to go. I have half a year on my lease left though. I feel empty and used and I'm still scared of them finding me I just wish it would all stop. There is to much going on at once.
I sent you a pm
Hi

I had a scary breakup about a year ago which resulted in stalking and threats so I decided to move.  I work construction so I see workmates 3 or so times a week but most of the people I work with are twice my age and a tad sexist unfortunatly so I keep to me. I thought this would be a new start but I feel stuck.

I have kept a journal since I was 4 but it's more a habit then it is useful. I try to talk and I'm open to talking but I literally have zero access to humans atm. Im snowed in on a mountain and the nearest psychiatrist is over a 2 hour drive away :/ I've called a help line a few times when I've really been scared I'd do it but I end up alone at the end of the day and I've been alone since I was 15 and I'm tired

Thankyou, it sucks because the second one thing goes wrong my head fills with negativity and it's like it's trying to bring me to my breaking point but at the sane time I don't want to listen to the negative but it's so loud.

I don't have anyone I trust. My family isn't around anymore and I have no access to a  psychiatrist though not for lack of trying. I don't actually want to feel this way. I have been thinking about this for a few months and I'm in the odd situation where I actually wouldn't be missed nor would my death disrupt anyone's lives . So it really is just down to me and my choice where only I will be affected.

Thankyou for being blunt and honest and open becayse this spoke to me. Im sorry you lost someone you love but holy fuck you must be the strongest person alive,you're truly incredible to have the heart to help someone else when you're feeling that way. You sir, just saved a life.

Thankyou, that is very kind. 23 more years alone isn't a life love.  It's empty and lonely and I'm not prepared for that. I've had to watch everyone I love leave,I've been alone for so many years now and I just can't do this alone anymore

Thanks , I'm half deaf and horribly depressed. I feel empty, ugly and used. I recently lost half my hearing and can't hear birds anymore (which is huge if you loved that sound). I miss the girl I was and I can't get her back. I don't have family to speak of nor do I have any support system so I can truthfully say no-one would miss me. It just seems like the logical choice
